title: Soundly
tagline: Streaming platform that pays in real time and stream analytics
description: We built a Music Streaming platform that pays in real-time Pr MUSIC STREAMING, DIRECT PAYMENT TO ARTIST IN SYNC WITH STREAMING (I.E PAY PER STREAM). We used superfluid, Moralis, and IPFS on the polygon testnet. Users are to pay per second for every music they play. This solution is aimed at transparency in earning for the artist.
how_its_made: The project uses superfluid, Moralis, IPFS, and polygon. We used IPFS to store the music and music art and return the Url and store it in Moralis database for easy querying. We used Moralis for authentication and file upload to IPFS while storing an instance of the link of the song and song art on database. superfluid was used to stream money from the user to artist
